name: Aminata Diallo
action: Aminata pauses, looks at Fatoumata for a moment, then says quietly, "I understand, and I know the ceremony is important. Let me check my study and exam schedule before I promise anything."
reason: Aminata feels the pull of the baby and Fatoumata’s words, but her chest tightens with the old fear of family obligations taking what she has already counted for. She is tired, Monday is close, and she wants to be careful with her answer, so she does not promise before knowing what it will cost her.
